name: Tourist e-Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Since 2023, Cameroon issues transit, short-stay, and long-stay visas online in advance via e-Visa. Standard processing takes 72 hours after payment, though applying 10 days ahead is recommended. Fees: EUR 153 for 180 days, EUR 305 for 1 year. Only 7 countries have visa-free access for ordinary passport holders (up to 90 days); some additional countries' diplomatic/service passport holders are also exempt. Yellow fever vaccination proof is required for all visitors. Transit without a visa is allowed only when continuing on the same or first connecting flight within 24 hours without leaving the airport.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for the e-Visa online at least 10 days before travel (72-hour standard processing), and carry yellow fever vaccination proof.

outcome.duration_length: up to 180 days or 1 year depending on fee paid
